name: AltNeRF
definition: A framework that creates resilient Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) representations using self-supervised monocular depth estimation (SMDE) from monocular videos, without relying on known camera poses. It uses an alternating algorithm to harmonize NeRF outputs with SMDE.
summary: AltNeRF is a NeRF framework for monocular videos that uses alternating optimization to harmonize scene geometry and camera poses with self-supervised depth priors.
